verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted URL-to-Markdown and search API, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair question for it. The evidence covers only synchronous request/response headers, caching, an S3 cache, and an MCP server, none of which are outbound HTTP callbacks. No documented webhook or event-subscription capability appears.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
